tools.name: get_company_buybacks_sbc
tools.description: Retrieve SEC EDGAR XBRL-backed Buybacks vs. Stock-Based Compensation (SBC), RSU tax withholdings, Standard FCF, SBC-Adjusted FCF (FCF minus SBC), cover-page shares vs. weighted-average diluted shares, per-metric filing provenance, split-basis mismatch flags, and anti-dilutive context for any of 10,4

tools.name: compare_companies_dilution
tools.description: Compare two U.S. public companies head-to-head on SEC EDGAR 10-K buybacks, stock-based compensation (SBC), RSU tax withholdings, SBC-Adjusted FCF (FCF minus SBC), per-metric filing provenance, and diluted share-count change.

tools.name: get_sec_screen
tools.description: Query WeightedShares quantitative SEC EDGAR screens across flagship U.S. companies: true share cannibals, largest buyback programs, heavy SBC diluters, negative SBC-adjusted FCF (excluding banks/insurers/REITs), RSU tax withholding financing outflows, or 12M Form 4 insider selling vs. buybacks.

tools.name: get_superinvestor_dilution
tools.description: Audit a legendary superinvestor's latest SEC Form 13F-HR (including 13F-NT notice manager attribution via otherManager sequence) U.S. equity holdings for weighted diluted share drift, SBC % of revenue, and SBC-Adjusted FCF margins with both top-N subset weights and reported 13F portfolio share. Pass
